title: Brand
subtitle: {{brand}} · identity, locale and domains for this brand only

general.heading: Identity
general.lead: Shown to customers in emails, the widget and the help center.
general.name: Brand name
general.prefixHint: Fixed at creation. It is printed in every ticket number.
general.localeHint: Used for auto-responders and the help center fallback.
general.timezoneHint: Business hours and SLA clocks use this unless a department overrides it.
general.failed: The brand could not be saved. Try again.
general.loadFailed: The brand could not be loaded.
general.whoBody: Admins of this brand. Team Leaders edit ticketing settings on the Ticketing page instead.

domains.heading: Help center domains
domains.lead: Your own address for the help center. The primary domain is the one in links, the sitemap and canonical tags.

add.label: Add a domain
add.hint: A host name only, without https:// or a path. You get the records to create next.

refusals.domain-invalid: Enter a host name such as support.example.com, without https:// or a path.
refusals.domain-not-public: That name can never be reached from the internet. Use a domain you own.
refusals.domain-reserved: That is one of this install's own host names.
refusals.domain-taken: That domain is already in use, by this brand or another one.
refusals.domain-limit: This brand already has {{max}} domains, the most it may have. Remove one first.
refusals.domain-not-verified: Only a verified domain can be the primary one.

state.issued: Verified · certificate issued {{date}}, renews by itself
state.tlsPending: Verified · the certificate is issued on the first visit
state.pendingNever: Waiting for DNS · not checked yet

failure.certificate_failed: DNS is verified, but HTTPS on this name did not answer with a valid certificate ({{detail}}). Check that ports 80 and 443 reach this server.
failure.cloudflare_not_flagged: DNS is verified, but the name resolves to Cloudflare ({{detail}}), so no certificate could be issued. If you proxy it through Cloudflare, turn on Proxied by Cloudflare. Otherwise set the record to DNS only.
failure.cname_mismatch: The CNAME record points at {{detail}}, not at {{target}}. Change it to the value below.
failure.records_removed: The TXT record is gone, so this domain is no longer verified and does not serve the help center. Publish the records again.

records.heading: Create these two records at your DNS provider

cloudflare.label: Proxied by Cloudflare
cloudflare.hint: Turn on if this record is proxied (orange cloud) in Cloudflare. Helpdock then does not request a certificate and Cloudflare serves HTTPS. The custom domains guide lists the SSL mode to use.

domains.dnsDelay: DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to show. Helpdock keeps checking; Check now looks at once.
domains.proxyOff: Mark as not proxied by Cloudflare

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{domain}}?
removeConfirm.body: The help center stops answering on this name, and no new certificate is issued for it. Its DNS records can be deleted afterwards.

toast.added: {{domain}} added. Create the two records shown under it.
toast.checking: Checking {{domain}}. The result shows here shortly.
toast.failed: That did not work. Try again.

domains.loadFailed: The domains could not be loaded.

empty.heading: No domains yet
empty.body: Add the host name customers should reach the help center on.

aside.label: About domains
aside.how2: Create the CNAME and TXT records.
aside.how3: Helpdock sees both and marks it verified.
aside.how4: The certificate is issued on the first visit, unless Cloudflare proxies it.
aside.stateVerified: Verified: DNS checks out and HTTPS works.
aside.statePending: Waiting: a record is missing or not seen yet.
aside.stateFailed: Failed: the reason is shown under the domain.
aside.widgetBefore: The sites allowed to embed the widget are set on
aside.whoBody: Admins of this brand. Adding, verifying and removing a domain is written to the audit log.

retention.heading: Data retention
retention.lead: Runs nightly. Purges are permanent and logged in the audit log with counts only.

rows.closedTicketsHint: Attachments, AI logs and CSAT follow the ticket.
rows.aiCallsHint: Prompt and response bodies are removed; counts and cost stay for reports.

retention.failed: The retention settings could not be saved. Try again.
retention.loadFailed: The retention settings could not be loaded.

errors.days: Enter a whole number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}.

erasure.heading: Erasing one person
erasure.body: Contact erasure lives on the contact page (Anonymise). It is immediate and not subject to these windows.
